title: Quenching Dutch Pasta Dish
description: A peppery and refreshing Dutch dish featuring paccheri pasta, perfect for curing hangovers, made with Mediterranean-friendly ingredients and finished under the broil for a glassy-jelly effect.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the paccheri pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced grilled chicken breast to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to release their juices.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked paccheri pasta, chicken and tomato mixture, and crumbled feta cheese.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta mixture and toss to combine.
Season the pasta mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Place the baking dish under the broil and cook until the top is lightly browned and the cheese is melted and glassy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
